drills.teacher_prompt_pt: Ouça a fórmula HNK e identifique a intenção comunicativa.
drills.hnk: KALA YA EN ES KU KE
authority_notes: PHR-001 is used as a recovered whole utterance with APPROXIMATE certainty.
YA and ES remain semantically unresolved.

drills.teacher_prompt_pt: Repita a fórmula HNK exatamente, sem decompor os tokens semanticamente.
drills.hnk: KALA YA EN ES KU KE
drills.expected: KALA YA EN ES KU KE
authority_notes: Whole-utterance validation only; no token gloss promotion.

drills.teacher_prompt_pt: Produza em HNK a pergunta de entrevista: Qual é o seu nome?
drills.hnk: KALA YA EN ES KU KE
drills.expected: KALA YA EN ES KU KE
authority_notes: Do not infer independent meanings for YA or ES from this exercise.

drills.teacher_prompt_pt: Trace a sequência estrutural de G-IDs da fórmula de nome.
drills.hnk: KALA YA EN ES KU KE
authority_notes: G-IDs are structural authority; Candidate D drawings are not visual canon.

drills.hnk: KALA YA EN ES KU KE
authority_notes: Bare personal-name response is validated for L01 OPI 1 only.

drills.hnk: KALA YA EN ES KU KE

expected.question: KALA YA EN ES KU KE

drills.teacher_prompt_pt: Ouça a pergunta HNK e identifique que o domínio é apelido/nome familiar.
authority_notes: VAMAKALA is FROZEN; the HAVE-like relation is not claimed as historical grammar.

drills.teacher_prompt_pt: Repita a pergunta nominal HNK de apelido.
authority_notes: EN ... KE use is scoped course grammar.

drills.teacher_prompt_pt: Produza em HNK a pergunta de entrevista sobre apelido.
authority_notes: Do not create or infer a separate HAVE verb.

drills.teacher_prompt_pt: Trace a sequência estrutural de G-IDs da pergunta de apelido.
authority_notes: G-IDs are structural authority; no visual-canon claim.

drills.teacher_prompt_pt: Responda à pergunta de apelido usando uma das duas rotas validadas.
authority_notes: NE remains AUTH-004 CANDIDATE and is scoped here through the validated OPI 2 response pattern.

drills.teacher_prompt_pt: Faça o microdiálogo completo de apelido, praticando resposta afirmativa e negativa em rodadas separadas.
authority_notes: No global negation or possession grammar is granted by this drill.
